nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the shared types package, extending a root config and including its source files.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Package manifest for the shared UI component library, declaring peer dependencies on React and Tailwind CSS with build and type entry points.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel entry point for the shared UI package, re-exporting the `cn` class-name utility and component modules.

nodes.name: StatsCard.tsx
nodes.summary: Reusable React stats card component that displays a labelled metric value with optional trend indicator and supports number, currency, and percentage formatting.

nodes.name: StatsCard

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the shared UI package, extending the monorepo base config with JSX support.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Package manifest for the web-gateway-client library, declaring axios as a runtime dependency with TypeScript build tooling.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Client library for communicating with the Cosmos web gateway, providing gateway URL resolution, an axios-based HTTP client factory with auth interceptors, and structured API error formatting.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses axios interceptors to inject JWT auth headers from localStorage and redirect to /login on 401 responses.

nodes.name: resolveGatewayBaseUrl
nodes.summary: Resolves the base URL for the web gateway, preferring an explicit override, then environment variable, then a default localhost address.

nodes.name: formatApiReachabilityError
nodes.summary: Produces a human-readable error message when the gateway API is unreachable, detecting ECONNREFUSED and CORS errors and suggesting the dev server port.

nodes.name: createGatewayApi
nodes.summary: Factory that creates a configured axios instance targeting the gateway API, with auth token injection, 401 redirect handling, and typed get/post/patch/delete helpers.

nodes.name: resolve-gateway.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the `resolveGatewayBaseUrl` function, verifying URL resolution logic under different environment configurations.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the web-gateway-client package, extending the monorepo base with module settings suited for a browser library.

nodes.name: clean-client-public.mjs
nodes.summary: Utility script that removes generated static assets from the admin client's public directory to ensure a clean build slate.

nodes.name: dev-admin.mjs
nodes.summary: Development launcher script for the admin app, spawning the Vite dev server with the appropriate configuration.

nodes.name: dev-web.mjs
nodes.summary: Development launcher script for the web (customer-facing) app, starting the Vite dev server with appropriate environment settings.

nodes.name: eslint-soft.mjs
nodes.summary: ESLint wrapper script that runs linting but exits with code 0 even on lint failures, used to surface warnings without blocking CI.

nodes.name: generate-all-prisma.mjs
nodes.summary: Script that runs `prisma generate` across all database schema packages in the monorepo to regenerate Prisma clients.

nodes.name: generate-favicons.mjs
nodes.summary: macOS-only script that uses the `sips` command-line tool to generate favicon PNG files at multiple sizes from a source SVG or PNG.
nodes.languageNotes: Relies on `sips`, the macOS image-processing CLI, making this non-portable outside macOS environments.

nodes.name: generate-types.ts
nodes.summary: TypeScript script that derives shared type definitions from Prisma schema models or other sources and writes them to the shared types package.

nodes.name: patch-client-after-sync.mjs
nodes.summary: Post-sync patching script that walks the synced client source tree and applies path or import adjustments needed after copying files from the web app.

nodes.name: production-preflight.mjs
nodes.summary: Pre-production checklist script that validates required environment variables and build artifacts are present before a deployment.

nodes.name: seed-db.ts
nodes.summary: Comprehensive database seeding script that populates all ERP domains — auth, inventory, CRM, orders, WMS, dispatch, compliance, ledger, payments, and notifications — with realistic demo data across multiple Prisma clients.
nodes.languageNotes: Dynamically imports each domain's Prisma client at runtime via `loadPrisma`, allowing the single script to target independent SQLite databases per domain.

nodes.name: seedAuth
nodes.summary: Seeds the auth database with a default tenant and two users (admin and viewer) with bcrypt-hashed passwords.

nodes.name: seedInventory
nodes.summary: Seeds the inventory database with warehouses, bin locations, SKUs, and stock levels for a demo tenant.

nodes.name: seedCrm
nodes.summary: Seeds the CRM database with customers, leads, activity records, and customer-specific pricing for a demo tenant.

nodes.name: seedOrders
nodes.summary: Seeds the orders database with realistic sales orders and line items, upserting or creating as needed.

nodes.name: seedWms
nodes.summary: Seeds the WMS database with fulfillment tasks, pick waves, receiving sessions, and cycle counts for a demo tenant.

nodes.name: seedCompliance
nodes.summary: Seeds the compliance database with MSA tenant records, manufacturer DIDs, transactions, and reports.

nodes.name: seedTier8Extras
nodes.summary: Seeds additional tier-8 ERP features including volume price breaks, order templates, extra bin locations, bank accounts, bank statement lines, and POS registers.

nodes.name: seedNotifications
nodes.summary: Seeds notification requests and updates tenant organization email settings for demo notification scenarios.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Top-level orchestrator that bootstraps environment variables and invokes all domain seed functions in dependency order.

nodes.name: setup-postgres.mjs
nodes.summary: Script that creates or verifies a PostgreSQL database and role for local development, using the psql CLI.

nodes.name: strip-web-ui.mjs
nodes.summary: Script that removes UI-only packages and components from the web app to produce a stripped distribution suitable for embedding in the admin shell.

nodes.name: sync-client-from-web.mjs
nodes.summary: Synchronisation script that copies and transforms selected pages and components from the web app into the admin client, rewriting import paths as needed.

nodes.name: transformSource
nodes.summary: Rewrites import path aliases and package references in source file content to make copied web-app files compatible with the admin client layout.

nodes.name: workspace-run.mjs
nodes.summary: Utility script that runs a given npm script across one or all workspace packages using `spawnSync`, supporting selective execution by package name.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Spawns an npm script in a specific workspace package directory, logging the package name and exiting the process on failure.
